source_binding: The final four-package race suite, policy check, and runtime profile bind all ten committed Go files. The final prose check binds the store contract. All intermediate runs preserve their own exact source hashes.
limits: Allocation regressions first failed on scalar encoding, generic containers, and repeated immutable payload encoding. Producer mutation also reproduced a published-provenance ownership failure. Their exact source and failed results remain archived.

Canonical JSON normalization bypasses redundant decoding for built-in scalars and generic maps and slices. Custom marshalers and source structs retain canonical normalization. Invalid JSON numbers and cycles still fail.

The immutable payload cache retains one validated payload per catalog, bounded by the existing 32 MiB limit. Each warm encoding returns one newly allocated caller-owned byte slice. Mutable builders do not cache payloads. Concurrent cold encoding, returned-byte mutation, and supported schema versions pass.

Immutable construction snapshots nested provenance and rejection slices. It normalizes custom values through lossless JSON with exact numbers and isolates each collection read. Published provenance can no longer diverge from its cached payload after producer or reader mutation.

The initial snapshot change exposed two record families whose typed YAML normalization disagreed with canonical JSON. The focused semantic regression also exposed metadata and pricing representation differences. Canonical comparison now uses JSON and retains field-scoped legacy aliases. Both payload and YAML workspace checks preserve original control-record receipts and policy refusal.
The first comment prose check failed. The corrected final source prose check passes without changing writing policy.

The final four-package suite passes 2120 test events, including parent events, with no failures or skips. The separate final runtime profile passes one import/restart test. Minimum-toolchain focused evidence predates only the private table-copy removal. Its 49 events do not fully qualify the final source on that toolchain.

Profiles report sampled cumulative allocation over a runtime import/restart test, not resident memory or Starport request allocations. Concurrent checking and single-run timing prevent a latency guarantee. The immutable ownership fix follows the earlier cache-only profile, so that earlier result is not a final-source measurement.
The final snapshot walks the private construction builder in place under its lock. This removes two redundant table copies while preserving independent nested values and caller-owned reads.

All current runtime-cost checks are terminal. The prior 30-minute runtime suite remains failed historical evidence in ../repeated-history-2026-09-12/verification.json. The full required task suite still needs final-source qualification.

Distinct-inventory retirement, generation and observation-file collection, twelve mapped task subcases, full verification, required review, native CI, and merge remain open. CSP5 remains unpublished until its full contract passes.
Five concurrent tooling edits remain outside this commit. Full task qualification must use the final committed module graph.
The final canonical prose check passes. Source snapshots separate the concurrent tooling edits from six owned documentation files. Task criteria, scope, invariants, and the goal remain unchanged.
